name: manual_29b258
claim: A single dependency's own advisory family can have multiple, differently-scoped instances in one repo (e.g. the same package resolved at two different major versions via two different parent dependency chains) -- fixing one instance does not close the Dependabot alert for the other. Check for sibling instances of the same package (npm ls / pnpm why across all resolutions) before declaring an advisory family closed.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-22: orama-system had brace-expansion at both 5.0.6 (via minimatch@10, typescript-eslint chain) and 1.1.15 (via minimatch@3.1.5, older eslint chain) -- each with its own Dependabot alert (#8 and #9) and its own vulnerable-range/fix-version pair. Fixed #8 first via a scoped pnpm override, correctly left #9's instance untouched at the time (different major API, needed separate handling) -- but should have checked for the sibling instance immediately rather than discovering it as a fresh alert later.
